aiMachineReadReview.question: Starting only from the English llms.txt, how do I install the public Python package and produce a first persistent APKG?
aiMachineReadReview.answer: I started at [the English llms.txt](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/llms.txt); its header already lists `python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1` (CPython 3.11+), and its Quickstarts entry led to [Generate an Anki APKG with Python](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/python-quickstart/index.md). Install: `python -m venv .venv`, activate with `. .venv/bin/activate` (Windows: `.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1`), then `python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1` from the public PyPI package. Requirement: ordinary CPython 3.11 or later with a matching platform wheel; recorded release checks cover CPython 3.11–3.14. The quickstart's "verified environments" target, read as [Compatibility Markdown](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/compatibility/index.md), names the native platforms (macOS arm64/x64, Linux x64 GNU/glibc, Windows x64) and says other Python implementations, free-threaded interpreters and subinterpreters need separate validation. First deck: save as main.py `from ankiforge import Project, Note, BuildOptions` / `project = Project('spanish', default_deck='Spanish')` / `project.add('es:hola', Note.basic('hola', 'hello'))` / `output = project.build(BuildOptions.to('spanish.apkg'))` / `print(output.artifact.path)`, then run `python main.py`. The result is the persistent `spanish.apkg` containing hola → hello in deck Spanish; open it in Anki to check. Keep namespace `spanish` and note key `es:hola` stable for later edits. Exporting does not require Anki. This is a documented answer from the HTTP bodies; I did not install the wheel or run the program.
conclusions: llms.txt → python-quickstart/index.md is a one-hop path; that Markdown alone carries the install commands, the CPython requirement and a complete first-deck program with its persistent output and stable identity.
The supported wheel platforms are stated only on the compatibility page, which I reached as Markdown through the llms "Start here" entry because the quickstart links the HTML page.

aiMachineReadReview.question: Starting only from the English llms.txt, what is the public Node/TypeScript API surface, and how do asynchronous build/compare, reports, artifact ownership and prepared publication behave?
aiMachineReadReview.answer: [llms.txt](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/llms.txt) gives the install line `npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1` (Node.js 22.13+) and its API references entry leads to [Node and TypeScript API](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/node-api/index.md). Surface (entry point `ankiforge`, one Project model): `new Project(namespace)`, `.defaultDeck(name)`, `.add(key, note)` (atomic, duplicate keys fail), `.addAsset(media)`, `.clone()`, `.length`; immutable `Note.basic(front, back)`, `Note.cloze(text)`, `model.note().field(key, content)`, `note.deck().tag().tags()`; custom models via `NoteType.builder(key)…field(new Field(...)).template(new Template(...)).build()` with `GenerationRule.all/any/ankiDefault`, and `await NoteType.fromBundle(path)`; content via `Content.html`/`Content.sequence`; media via `await Media.file(path, limits?)` / `await Media.bytes(bytes, mime, limits?)` (owned snapshots, default 256 MiB) and `.image()`/`.sound()`; Image Occlusion via `Note.imageOcclusion(image).mask(Mask.rect(...)).mode(...).build()`. Build/compare: `await project.build(BuildOptions.to(path))` (persistent) or `BuildOptions.temporary()` resolves to `BuildOutput` (`.artifact`, `.report`, `.snapshot()`); `await project.compare(CompareOptions.against(path))` resolves to a completed `ComparisonReport` even when policy blocks; options `.updateFrom(path)`, `.inspectLimits(...)`, `.updatePolicy(new UpdatePolicy().failOn('medium').allow('RISK.NOTE_REMOVED'))`. `BuildReport` (`.counts`, `.baselineCounts`, `.durationMs`, `.diagnostics`, `.comparison` = ComparisonReport or null) holds observations only, no outcome or file; `ComparisonReport` exposes `.findings`, `.highestRisk`, `.policy`, `.diagnostics`; `.snapshot()` JSON keeps Rust snake_case (`allows_publication`, `schema_version`). Async behaviour: build and compare run on an owned project snapshot captured at invocation, so later edits cannot change that request; media reads and bundle loads also run on workers; ESM and CJS share one native module. Ownership: keep an artifact owner alive while using `.path`; `await artifact.close()` releases it, the last temporary owner deletes the file, `await persistTo(path)` returns a persistent artifact, persistent files survive close ([build guarantees](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/build-guarantees/index.md) states the same snapshot and `close()` rules). Errors extend `ForgeError` (`kind`, `code`, `domain`, `causes`, `sourceDetails`, `details`); `BuildError.snapshot()` carries outcome/publication facts. Prepared publication (public 0.3.1): `await project.preparePublication(BuildOptions.to(next).updateFrom(prev))`, inspect `prepared.report`, `await prepared.publish()` (every attempt consumes the owner; repeats reject with `PreparedPublicationStateError`/`BUILD.PREPARED_UNAVAILABLE`), and `await prepared.close()` in `finally`. TypeScript: install `typescript` and `@types/node`, use `.mts` or `"type": "module"` with a NodeNext tsconfig, `npx tsc`, then `node dist/main.mjs`. Answer from reading only; no Node program was run.
conclusions: The Node Markdown answers the surface, async snapshot semantics, ownership, report/error shapes and prepared publication with tables and complete examples; nothing required for this question was missing.

Outside the machine path, I spot-checked two accessor claims against repository sources (Node Project.add returns this; Node ComparisonReport.policy returns the snake_case snapshot policy; Python allows_publication is a property): consistent with the docs. This does not prove the published 0.3.1 package.

aiMachineReadReview.question: Starting only from the English llms.txt, how do I generate a deck from JSON with image and audio media, and review an answer-only update against the original distribution APKG?
aiMachineReadReview.answer: [llms.txt](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/llms.txt) → [Generate and update Anki decks from JSON](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/json-to-anki/index.md). Inputs: download v1.json, v2.json, cell.png and tone.wav from `https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/generated/recipes/json-to-anki/` into `recipe/` (all four returned 200 over HTTP; both JSON files hold namespace `biology-json`, deck `Biology` and notes `bio:cell`, `bio:nucleus`, `bio:membrane`; v2 changes only the bio:cell answer from "A unit of life" to "The basic structural and functional unit of life"). Choose one complete program pinned to public 0.3.1: Rust 1.92+ (`cargo new json-deck`, `cargo add ankiforge@0.3.1`, `cargo add serde --features derive`, `cargo add serde_json`; `cargo run -- recipe output/rust`), Python CPython 3.11+ (venv, `python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1`; `python main.py recipe output/python`) or Node 22.13+ (`npm init -y`, `npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1`, `npm install --save-dev typescript@6.0.3 @types/node@24.13.6`; `npx tsc main.mts --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --outDir dist --types node`; `node dist/main.mjs recipe output/node`). The application parses the JSON; each front is `Content.sequence([front, image.image(), audio.sound()])` in `Note.basic(front, back)` keyed by the JSON id. Flow: refuse an output directory that already holds v1/v2; build `v1.apkg`; compare the v2 project against v1 and write `comparison.json`, stopping if policy blocks; `prepare_publication(BuildOptions.to(v2).update_from(v1))`, write the prepared report's comparison to `review.json`, re-check policy, `publish()` and print `output/<language>/v2.apkg`. Expected: 3 notes, 3 cards and 2 media files per release; comparison.json and review.json record `RISK.NOTE_CHANGED`, no added or removed notes and `policy.allows_publication: true`. Import v1 (Biology deck, three Basic cards, image and tone), then v2: the first answer changes and three notes remain. Baseline rules from [updates](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/updates/index.md) and [build guarantees](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/build-guarantees/index.md): keep the namespace and three keys; use the original distribution v1.apkg (it embeds `ankiforge-identity.json`, format `ankiforge-identity-v1`), never an Anki re-export; missing/corrupt evidence, namespace mismatch and exhausted inspection limits are hard errors; the default policy blocks High/Critical and `allow` accepts a whole category; publication atomically replaces only the APKG, policy rejection does not replace it, and every publish attempt consumes the prepared owner. Anki caveats: importing does not delete omitted notes; local edits, scheduling and schema/sort-field changes depend on client version and import settings, so test target clients. Counts and RISK codes are documented expectations; I did not run an SDK.
conclusions: The JSON guide is self-contained for Rust, Python and Node; the shared inputs downloaded over HTTP match the guide's description of the data and the expected first answer.
Baseline, policy and publication semantics agree across json-to-anki, updates and build-guarantees.

aiMachineReadReview.question: Starting only from the English llms.txt, which packages are published, which runtime versions/platforms are verified or excluded, and which Anki client conditions apply?
aiMachineReadReview.answer: [llms.txt](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/llms.txt) "Start here" → [Compatibility and releases](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/compatibility/index.md). Published packages: ankiforge 0.3.1 on crates.io, npm and PyPI (as checked on 2026-10-13). Runtimes and recorded verification: Rust 1.92.0 and current stable (packaged consumers on all four supported platforms plus a fresh crates.io consumer); Node 22.13.0 and current 22, 24 and 26 (16 public npm installation, ESM/CJS and TypeScript checks); ordinary CPython 3.11–3.14 (16 isolated PyPI wheel installation checks). Native packages cover macOS arm64/x64, Linux x64 GNU/glibc and Windows x64; package availability alone is not a successful runtime test on every host. Outside the recorded Node scope: browser, Electron, Bun, Alpine/musl and ARM64 Linux/Windows; other Python implementations, free-threaded interpreters and subinterpreters need separate validation. The successful 0.3.1 Rust, npm and PyPI release runs are linked (GitHub Actions), and batch media and prepared publication are in the public 0.3.1 packages. Client conditions: normal export needs no Anki; import, rendering and media playback depend on the target client's version, codecs and import settings; the 2026-10-08 benchmark passed 40 import/content/representative-render checks (20 per implementation), not every client or GUI/audio behaviour. For updates keep the previous original distribution APKG (Anki re-exports lack the identity evidence); omitting a note does not delete it from a learner's collection; field/template changes, sort fields, local edits and review history need client-specific testing with the linked manual client scenarios. The llms header agrees (0.3.1; Rust 1.92+, Node.js 22.13+, CPython 3.11+; export without Anki; keep the original APKG; published APIs differ from source builds). Dates and counts are as stated by the site; I did not re-check registries, release runs or Anki clients.

aiMachineReadReview.question: 仅从中文 llms.txt 出发，如何安装公开 Python 包并生成第一个持久保存的 APKG？
aiMachineReadReview.answer: 从[中文 llms.txt](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/llms.txt)开始：索引头部已给出 `python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1`（CPython 3.11+），“快速开始”条目指向[用 Python 生成 Anki APKG](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/python-quickstart/index.md)。安装：`python -m venv .venv`，用 `. .venv/bin/activate` 激活（Windows 用 `.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1`），再从公开 PyPI 包执行 `python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1`。要求普通 CPython 3.11 或更高版本及匹配的平台 wheel；发布检查覆盖 CPython 3.11–3.14。快速入门“已验证环境”的目标按 Markdown 读取为[中文兼容性页](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/compatibility/index.md)，其中列出原生包平台 macOS arm64/x64、Linux x64 GNU/glibc、Windows x64，并说明其他 Python 实现、自由线程解释器与子解释器需单独验证。首个牌组：把 `from ankiforge import Project, Note, BuildOptions` / `project = Project('spanish', default_deck='Spanish')` / `project.add('es:hola', Note.basic('hola', 'hello'))` / `output = project.build(BuildOptions.to('spanish.apkg'))` / `print(output.artifact.path)` 保存为 main.py，运行 `python main.py`。结果是持久保存的 `spanish.apkg`，Spanish 牌组包含 hola → hello，可在 Anki 中打开检查；后续编辑保持命名空间 `spanish` 和笔记键 `es:hola` 不变。导出不需要安装 Anki。以上答案只来自中文 HTTP 正文，未回退英文；本次未实际安装或运行。
conclusions: 中文 llms.txt → 中文 python-quickstart/index.md 一跳可达；该 Markdown 本身包含安装命令、CPython 要求、完整首个牌组程序、持久输出和稳定身份说明，无需英文。
wheel 支持平台只在兼容性页说明；快速入门的正文链接指向 HTML 页面，我通过中文 llms“从这里开始”条目以 Markdown 读取。

aiMachineReadReview.question: 仅从中文 llms.txt 出发，Node/TypeScript 公开 API 有哪些，异步构建/比较、报告、产物所有权与预备发布如何工作？
aiMachineReadReview.answer: [中文 llms.txt](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/llms.txt)给出 `npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1`（Node.js 22.13+），“API 参考”条目指向[Node 与 TypeScript API](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/node-api/index.md)。公开面（入口 `ankiforge`，唯一 Project 模型）：`new Project(namespace)`、`.defaultDeck(name)`、`.add(key, note)`（原子收集，重复键失败）、`.addAsset(media)`、`.clone()`、`.length`；不可变的 `Note.basic`、`Note.cloze`、`model.note().field(key, content)`、`note.deck().tag().tags()`；`NoteType.builder(key)…field(new Field(...)).template(new Template(...)).build()` 构建不可变模型，`GenerationRule.all/any/ankiDefault`，`await NoteType.fromBundle(path)`；`Content.html`/`Content.sequence`；`await Media.file(path, limits?)` 与 `await Media.bytes(bytes, mime, limits?)` 返回拥有所有权的快照（默认 256 MiB），`.image()`/`.sound()` 生成类型化内容；`Note.imageOcclusion(image).mask(Mask.rect(...)).mode(...).build()`。构建与比较：`await project.build(BuildOptions.to(path))`（持久）或 `BuildOptions.temporary()` 得到 `BuildOutput`（`.artifact`、`.report`、`.snapshot()`）；`await project.compare(CompareOptions.against(path))` 即使策略阻止也返回完成的 `ComparisonReport`；选项 `.updateFrom(path)`、`.inspectLimits(...)`、`.updatePolicy(new UpdatePolicy().failOn('medium').allow('RISK.NOTE_REMOVED'))`。`BuildReport`（`.counts`、`.baselineCounts`、`.durationMs`、`.diagnostics`、`.comparison` 为 ComparisonReport 或 null）只含观察结果，不含结果或文件所有权；比较对象提供 `.findings`、`.highestRisk`、`.policy`、`.diagnostics`；`.snapshot()` 的 JSON 保留 Rust 的 snake_case（`allows_publication`、`schema_version`）。异步：build 与 compare 使用调用时捕获并拥有的项目快照，后续编辑不影响该请求；媒体读取与模板包加载也在工作线程执行；ESM 与 CJS 共享同一原生模块。所有权：使用 `.path` 时保持所有者存活，`await artifact.close()` 释放，最后一个临时所有者删除文件，`await persistTo(path)` 返回持久产物，持久文件在关闭后仍存在（[构建保证](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/build-guarantees/index.md)给出相同的快照与 `close()` 规则）。错误继承 `ForgeError`（`kind`、`code`、`domain`、`causes`、`sourceDetails`、`details`），`BuildError.snapshot()` 保留结果与发布事实。预备发布（公开 0.3.1）：`await project.preparePublication(BuildOptions.to(next).updateFrom(prev))`，审阅 `prepared.report`，`await prepared.publish()`（每次尝试都消耗所有者，重复调用以 `PreparedPublicationStateError`/`BUILD.PREPARED_UNAVAILABLE` 拒绝），在 `finally` 中 `await prepared.close()`。TypeScript：安装 `typescript` 与 `@types/node`，使用 `.mts` 或 `"type": "module"` 及 NodeNext 配置，`npx tsc` 后运行 `node dist/main.mjs`。仅读取中文正文作答，未运行 Node。
conclusions: 中文 Node Markdown 以表格和完整示例覆盖 API 面、异步快照语义、所有权、报告/错误形状与预备发布，作答所需内容完整。
代码示例中的注释保持英文，不影响理解；全部站内链接均为同语言（zh-cn）页面。

aiMachineReadReview.question: 仅从中文 llms.txt 出发，如何从 JSON 生成含图片和音频的牌组，并以原始分发 APKG 为基线检查仅修改答案的更新？
aiMachineReadReview.answer: [中文 llms.txt](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/llms.txt) → [用 JSON 数据生成并更新 Anki 牌组](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/json-to-anki/index.md)。输入：从 `https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/generated/recipes/json-to-anki/` 下载 v1.json、v2.json、cell.png、tone.wav 放入 `recipe/`（四个共享文件本次 HTTP 均返回 200；两份 JSON 的命名空间为 `biology-json`、牌组 `Biology`、笔记 `bio:cell`、`bio:nucleus`、`bio:membrane`；v2 只把 bio:cell 的答案由 “A unit of life” 改为 “The basic structural and functional unit of life”）。任选一份固定公开 0.3.1 的完整程序：Rust 1.92+（`cargo new json-deck`、`cargo add ankiforge@0.3.1`、`cargo add serde --features derive`、`cargo add serde_json`；`cargo run -- recipe output/rust`）、Python CPython 3.11+（venv，`python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1`；`python main.py recipe output/python`）或 Node 22.13+（`npm init -y`、`npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1`、`npm install --save-dev typescript@6.0.3 @types/node@24.13.6`；`npx tsc main.mts --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --outDir dist --types node`；`node dist/main.mjs recipe output/node`）。JSON 由应用解析；正面为 `Content.sequence([front, image.image(), audio.sound()])`，以 JSON id 为键加入 `Note.basic(front, back)`。流程：输出目录已含 v1/v2 时拒绝；构建 `v1.apkg`；用 v2 项目对 v1 比较并写 `comparison.json`，策略阻止则停止；`prepare_publication(BuildOptions.to(v2).update_from(v1))`，把预备报告的比较写入 `review.json`，再次检查策略后 `publish()`，输出 `output/<language>/v2.apkg`。预期：每版 3 条笔记、3 张卡片、2 个媒体文件；comparison.json 与 review.json 记录 `RISK.NOTE_CHANGED`、无新增/移除笔记、`policy.allows_publication: true`。先导入 v1（Biology 牌组三张 Basic 卡片、细胞图与合成音），再导入 v2：第一个答案变化，仍为三条笔记。基线规则（[更新](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/updates/index.md)、[构建保证](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/build-guarantees/index.md)）：保持命名空间与三个键；基线必须是原始分发 v1.apkg（内含 `ankiforge-identity.json`，格式 `ankiforge-identity-v1`），不能用 Anki 重新导出；证据缺失/损坏、命名空间不匹配和检查预算耗尽是硬错误；默认策略阻止 High/Critical，`allow` 放行整个类别；发布只原子替换 APKG，策略拒绝不替换输出，每次 publish 尝试都消耗预备所有者。Anki 条件：导入不会删除省略的笔记；本地编辑、调度及 schema/排序字段变化取决于客户端版本和导入设置，需验证目标客户端。数量与风险码是文档给出的预期，本次未执行 SDK。
conclusions: 中文 JSON 指南对 Rust、Python、Node 三种 SDK 都是完整程序；共享输入与英文页相同（数据、错误消息为英文），页面明确写出预期英文答案，不构成误导。
基线、策略与发布语义在中文 json-to-anki、updates、build-guarantees 三页间一致。

aiMachineReadReview.answer: [中文 llms.txt](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/llms.txt)“从这里开始” → [兼容性与发布](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/compatibility/index.md)。公开包：截至 2026-10-13，crates.io、npm、PyPI 上的 ankiforge 均为 0.3.1。运行环境与记录的验证：Rust 1.92.0 与当前稳定版（四个支持平台的打包消费者及全新 crates.io 消费者）；Node 22.13.0 与当前 22、24、26（16 项公开 npm 安装、ESM/CJS 和 TypeScript 检查）；普通 CPython 3.11–3.14（16 项隔离的 PyPI wheel 安装检查）。原生包覆盖 macOS arm64/x64、Linux x64 GNU/glibc、Windows x64；存在安装包不等于每台主机都通过运行测试。不在现有 Node 验证范围内：浏览器、Electron、Bun、Alpine/musl、ARM64 Linux/Windows；其他 Python 实现、自由线程解释器与子解释器需单独验证。页面链接了成功的 0.3.1 Rust/npm/PyPI 发布运行（GitHub Actions），并说明批量媒体与预备发布已包含在公开 0.3.1 包中。客户端条件：普通导出不需要 Anki；导入、渲染和播放媒体取决于目标客户端版本、编解码器与导入设置；2026-10-08 基准测试通过 40 项导入、内容和代表性渲染检查（每个实现 20 项），并未覆盖所有客户端或 GUI/音频行为。更新时保留之前的原始分发 APKG（Anki 重新导出不保留所需身份证据）；包中省略的笔记不会从学习者集合中删除；字段/模板变化、排序字段、本地编辑和复习历史需按客户端测试，可使用链接的手动客户端场景。中文索引头部一致（0.3.1；Rust 1.92+、Node.js 22.13+、CPython 3.11+；导出无需 Anki；保留原始 APKG；公开包 API 与源码构建不同）。日期和数量按页面所述，本次未重新核对注册表、发布运行或 Anki 客户端。
conclusions: 中文兼容性页保留了日期、运行环境表、明确的不覆盖范围和 Anki 客户端条件，没有夸大验证范围。
中文索引摘要与正文一致（版本、无需 Anki 导出、原始 APKG 要求）。
